_comment: This file is the single source of truth for deployed protocol addresses.
Descriptions state which protocol uses each contract and how that contract is used.
proxyOf is null for a non-proxy and otherwise lists known implementations as [address, fromBlock].
Implementation histories are informative and retain old implementations for validation or verification.
The most recent known implementation is first; fromBlock is when it became active and may be null or ignored.
The TypeScript exports derive their metadata and address-only lookups from this file.

governor.description: For MoC and RoC, governance executor authorized to run approved protocol changes.

mocRegistry.description: For MoC and RoC, governed registry of legacy MoC and shared flow contracts.

mocToken.description: For MoC and RoC, canonical MOC governance and fee token.

docToken.description: For MoC and RoC, canonical DOC stable token shared by the legacy MoC and RoC integrations.

mocStateV1.description: For MoC and RoC, legacy MoC v1 state and pricing contract.

supporters.description: For MoC and RoC, Oracle Supporters proxy that accounts for stake and distributes oracle rewards.

foundation.description: For MoC and RoC, protocol foundation or treasury recipient used by fee-distribution contracts.

tasksRunner.description: For MoC and RoC, stable TasksRunner proxy used by selected oracles to execute scheduled protocol maintenance.

docToRbtcPriceProvider.description: For MoC and RoC, price provider quoting DOC in RBTC. Use when a consumer explicitly requires a DOC/RBTC price.

rbtcToMocMocRewardsReverseAuction.description: For MoC and RoC, reverse auction converting RBTC into MOC for the MOC rewards buffer.

mocV1.description: For MoC, stable proxy for the legacy Money on Chain v1 core protocol.

mocInrateV1.description: For MoC, legacy MoC v1 interest-rate and commission contract.

coiner.description: For MoC and shared governance, stable Coiner proxy used by the shared reward-minting flow. Use the proxy address, never an implementation address.

multicall2.description: For MoC and RoC, shared Multicall2 deployment used to batch read-only calls. It is infrastructure, not a protocol-owned proxy.

vendor.description: For MoC, vendor account supplied by the MoC application so operations can be attributed for vendor commissions.

rns.description: For MoC, canonical Rootstock Name Service registry for this network.

mocMultiCollateralGuard.description: For RoC, stable proxy coordinating operations across the RIF-backed and DOC-backed collateral buckets.

rifToken.description: For RoC, canonical RIF token used as collateral by the RIF-backed RoC bucket.

rifProToken.description: For RoC, current RIFPro collateral token used by the RIF-backed RoC bucket.

usdRifToken.description: For RoC, canonical USD-RIF pegged token used by RoC collateral buckets.

docProToken.description: For RoC, collateral token associated with the DOC-backed RoC bucket; it is not the DOC stable token.

rifBucket.description: For RoC, stable proxy for the RIF-backed RoC collateral bucket whose pegged token is USD-RIF.

docBucket.description: For RoC, RoC multi-collateral bucket backed by DOC and serving USD-RIF operations. This is the stable bucket proxy.

rifQueue.description: For RoC, operation queue used by the RIF collateral bucket. Use the proxy address for queue calls.

docQueue.description: For RoC, operation queue used by the DOC collateral bucket. Use the proxy address for queue calls.

rifUsdLegacyPriceProvider.description: For RoC, legacy RIF/USD provider retained for contracts that have not moved to rifUsdCoinPair.

rifToRbtcPriceProvider.description: For RoC, final provider quoting RIF in RBTC for protocol consumers.

docToUsdRifPriceProvider.description: For RoC, price provider quoting DOC in USD-RIF for interactions between the DOC and RIF collateral buckets.

mocToRifBasePriceProvider.description: For RoC, base provider used to derive a MOC/RIF price. Prefer the final directional provider when one is available.

rifToRbtcDivisorPriceProvider.description: For RoC, divisor input used to derive RIF/RBTC pricing. Prefer rifToRbtcPriceProvider for the final quote.

btcUsdCoinPair.description: For RoC, canonical decentralized BTC/USD oracle coin pair used by protocol price providers and automation.

holder.description: For RoC, funded account used by tests and operational simulations. Do not treat it as a protocol contract.

oracleOwner1.description: For RoC, known oracle-owner account used by the configured oracle network. This is an account, not an oracle signing key.

oracleOwner2.description: For RoC, known oracle-owner account used by the configured oracle network. This is an account, not an oracle signing key.

oracleOwner3.description: For RoC, known oracle-owner account used by the configured oracle network. This is an account, not an oracle signing key.

mocCommissionSplitterV2.description: For RoC, live version-2 splitter for MOC-denominated commissions.

mocCommissionSplitterV3.description: For RoC, live version-3 splitter for MOC-denominated commissions.

rifProRewardsBuffer.description: For RoC, buffer that accumulates RIFPro rewards before automated distribution.

rocrRewardsBuffer.description: For RoC, legacy buffer that accumulates ROCR rewards before automated distribution.

bproRewardsBuffer.description: For RoC, legacy buffer that accumulates BPro rewards before automated distribution. Use this only for the legacy BPro reward flow.

mocRewardsBuffer.description: For RoC, buffer that receives MOC rewards before they are distributed through the automated rewards flow.

rifUsdCoinPair.description: For RoC, decentralized RIF/USD oracle coin pair introduced for the current RoC price flow.

rbtcToMocPriceProvider.description: For RoC, price provider quoting RBTC in MOC for RBTC-to-MOC auctions.

rifToMocPriceProvider.description: For RoC, final provider quoting RIF in MOC. This is the provider installed in the active RIF-to-MOC auctions.

mocUpgradeDelegator.description: For MoC, governance-controlled delegator authorized to upgrade the legacy MoC v1 proxies.

votingUpgradeDelegator.description: For shared governance, delegator authorized to upgrade the VotingMachine proxy after governance approval.
